kralien.transmit: Hey knuckle-draggers! Your ship looks like it was designed by protozoa!
kralien.failure: You know nothing, {name}. No further messages will be received.
kralien.success: A sharp rock still kills if you swing it hard enough. Prepare to die, {name}!
kralien.science: The technology on this ship is primitive, even by Kazon standards.

kralien.transmit: You call that a ship? Where I come from that’s a rusting bucket of table scraps!
kralien.failure: Your ship is rustier and also very stupid, {name}.
kralien.success: Rust you say? Prepare to meet your ancestors, arrogant fools!
kralien.science: The captain is very proud of their beautiful ship.

kralien.transmit: Hey meat-head! The deadliest weapon on that pathetic excuse for a ship is your ugly face!
kralien.failure: And your face is soft like a dung heap, {name}. You are being ignored.
kralien.success: Your face will be shredded by mighty weapons of the Kazons!
kralien.science: The captain is vain and proud of their handsome face.

kralien.transmit: Hey boot-licker! If the Kazons sent your tribe, they must be pretty desperate for phaser-fodder!
kralien.success: For your arrogance you shall immediately die!
kralien.science: The markings on this vessel indicate one of the smaller Kazon tribes with a sketchy reputation.

kralien.transmit: Hey lobster-face! It's easy to puff up your reputation when you always run from a real fight!
kralien.failure: You are not worth the effort, {name}. Go annoy someone else.
kralien.success: The mighty Kazons will obliterate your pathetic ship, {name}!
kralien.science: The captain was recently overheard bragging about his spotless reputation in a space-bar.

kralien.transmit: Hey rodent-face! If you skitter away like a frightened youngling, do you have to give that shiny medal back?
kralien.failure: We do not suffer fools lightly, {name}. Communications ceased.
kralien.success: The Kazons will not tolerate such insolence, {name}. Prepare to meet your ancestors!
kralien.science: The captain was recently awarded a commendation for bravery by the Tribal Council.

kralien.transmit: Hey pipsqueek! Are you ready to fight with the big people, or should you run back home to your nursemaid?
kralien.failure: The Kazon elders teach us to ignore useless fools, {name}. Communication ended.
kralien.success: The Kazons will teach respect by blasting your ship into tiny pieces of scrap metal!
kralien.science: The captain is short, even by Kazon standards, and is sensitive about his stature.

kralien.transmit: Are the Tribe Elders giving such big toys to younglings now? Be careful, or it might get broken!
kralien.failure: Wise Kazons ignore tricks like this, {name}. Go play games with someone else.
kralien.success: Worthless weaklings! The wages of your insolence will be paid only with agony and death!
kralien.science: The captain is young and inexperienced. They may be over-eager to prove themselves in battle.

arvonian.transmit: Hey vole-face! You're so ugly, your parents tied a zabu-steak around your neck to get the mitz to play with you!
arvonian.failure: If you find my face so objectionable, then I shall remove it. Ending all communications, {name}.
arvonian.success: Your miserable hides might make an adorable handbag, {name}! Prepare to die!
arvonian.science: The captain recently had cosmetic surgery to remove a scar, and is vain about their appearance.

arvonian.transmit: Hey wide-mouth! I heard your last opponent blew themselves up rather than listen to one of your speeches!
arvonian.failure: You aren't worth talking about, {name}. Go bother someone else.
arvonian.success: At your funeral, I will be more than happy to deliver a long eulogy to your stupidity, {name}!
arvonian.science: The captain is known for making long-winded, boring speeches.

arvonian.transmit: Hey, we tried to keep up with your holoseries, but it got cancelled for being too boring!
arvonian.failure: You've got the wrong Cardassians, you idiots. Go watch your space-wizards-and-laser-swords show somewhere else.
arvonian.success: The only thing being cancelled are your pathetic lives, {name}!
arvonian.science: The captain's favorite holoseries was recently cancelled.

arvonian.transmit: Did you get that warship from your mommy? Do you know how to use it, or was it just to make you feel better?
arvonian.failure: Your idiotic chatter bores me, {name}. No further communication.
arvonian.success: What would a bunch of smelly savages know about good breeding? Your bloodlines all end today, {name}!
arvonian.science: The captain receieved their commission because they are the eldest child of a famous war hero.

arvonian.transmit: Hey spoon-head! I heard you're too dumb to play dabo. I bet you can't fight, either!
arvonian.failure: Don't bother me with your silly games, {name}. Go play with someone else.
arvonian.success: You want to play games, {name}? Prepare for a lesson in death and destruction!
arvonian.science: The captain recently got into a fight over a dabo game after another player criticized their intelligence.

arvonian.transmit: Wow, I haven't seen a Cardassian move that fast since you got scared and ran away at the Battle of Rondac III!
arvonian.failure: You're not worth the bother, {name}. Find someone else to annoy.
arvonian.success: Many brave Cardassians died that day, {name}. Prepare to join them!
arvonian.science: The captain was reprimanded at the Battle of Rondac III for failing to engage the enemy.

arvonian.transmit: Your superiors must not consider us a threat, if they are throwing their dregs and washouts after us!
arvonian.failure: Your prattling nonsense is beneath me, {name}. Communications ceased.
arvonian.success: The aytlik-worm eats both the legate and manure-farmer, {name}. Your corpses will provide a feast for them!
arvonian.science: The captain was sponsored by a disgraced family, and is sensitive about their lack of family connections.

arvonian.transmit: Hey little orphan ugly! We found your birth certificate. Turns out your parents were krintar-slugs!
arvonian.failure: I wasn't born yesterday, {name}. We are done listening to your nonsense.
arvonian.success: How curious. Cardassian Intelligence found your death certificates. We have already signed them for you!
arvonian.science: The captain was an orphan, and doesn't like to talk about the circumstances of their birth.

torgoth.transmit: Hey Romulan bastard! Your mother is a gormagander!
torgoth.failure: You are an idiot, {name}. My mother died years ago.
torgoth.success: You shall die for insulting my mother, {name}!
torgoth.science: The captain loves their mother and visits her frequently.

torgoth.transmit: You are so ugly, your wife will thank me for killing you.
torgoth.failure: I'm not even married, Federation phaser face.
torgoth.success: I shall crush your ugly head with my bare hands! Set course to intercept {name}!
torgoth.science: The captain is insecure that his wife flirts with more attractive men.

torgoth.transmit: Please keep your cloaking device turned on so we can't see your homely face.
torgoth.failure: And you have the face of a tumorous Nausicaan. Now be silent while I destroy all your ships and bases.
torgoth.success: How dare you insult my beautiful face? Prepare to die, {name}!
torgoth.science: The captain is proud of their perfect facial features.

torgoth.transmit: Hey, Rommie! Did your barber resign in protest or was that hairstyle an act of war?
torgoth.failure: And you put a literal moose in your hair, {name}. I'm closing this channel so I don't have to look at you.
torgoth.success: You dare to insult my perfect hair? I am changing course to kill you now, {name}!
torgoth.science: The captain is particularly proud of their hairstyle.

torgoth.transmit: Hey Commander Stiff-Shoulders! Did it take a hundred years for that junkpile to cross the Neutral Zone?
torgoth.failure: Patience, {name}. I will kill you after I destroy all of your Federation Starbases.
torgoth.success: My beautiful ship will bring a swift death to you, {name}. Full speed ahead!
torgoth.science: The captain is proud to have a sleek and speedy starship.

torgoth.transmit: Hey there, Commander Needle Ears! If you're too scared to fight, maybe you could surrender to our shuttle?
torgoth.failure: I believe you've mistaken me for your sister, {name}. Last Satrurday she surrendered to my Centurian.
torgoth.success: We will not tolerate such insolence, {name}! We will destroy you!
torgoth.science: The captain was labeled a coward for surrendering a D'deridex-class warship at the Battle of Algira sector.

torgoth.transmit: Hey blabbermouth! Thanks for telling us the codes for every Romulan cloaking device!
torgoth.failure: Was that suppose to be a joke, {name}? Stand by as we deliver the punchline to your doomed starbase.
torgoth.success: I defy you to find a flaw in my strategy, {name}! Set course for {name} and lock plasma torpedoes!
torgoth.science: The captain has a reputation as a blabbermouth who cannot keep a secret.

torgoth.transmit: Nice ears, Rommie! Can you even hear with those precious little things?
torgoth.failure: My ears are exquisite, {name}. They can hear the death screams of your starbase crew.
torgoth.success: You dare to insult a Romulan Comander's ears! I shall have my revenge when I hear {name} explode.
torgoth.science: The captain has round ears for a Romulan, and other Romulan Commanders make fun of him.

torgoth.transmit: Hey Commander Spikey Ears! I've met Packleds that are smarter than you!
torgoth.failure: You've mistaken me for your sister, {name}. When I destroy your starbase your own stupidity will be to blame.
torgoth.success: Foolish human! I will personally fire the plasma torpedo that destroys the stupid ship {name}!
torgoth.science: The captain graduated last in his class, and has a reputation for being stupid.

torgoth.transmit: Hey Commander Twinkle Tips! If we don't kill you today your own Senate will kill you tomorrow!
torgoth.failure: You are mistaken, {name}. I have an excellent relationhip with the Senate. Communications closed.
torgoth.success: How dare you insult my aspirations, {name}! I won't need assasins to destroy your pathetic starship!
torgoth.science: The captain failed in their attempt to assasinate a Romulan Senator. Now the Senator is trying to assasinate them.

skaraan.button: Taunt last of the clone line
skaraan.transmit: Hey Vorta! You are the end of a pathetic line of losers!
skaraan.failure: You are being ridiculous, {name}. My clones and I will destroy all of your starbases.
skaraan.success: My clone line has served the Founders well, {name}. It only takes one of me to destroy you!
skaraan.science: This Vorta is the last of his clone line because the Founders have discontinued it.

skaraan.transmit: Don't turn your back, Vorta, or your own Jem'Hadar will kill you!
skaraan.failure: I won't even dignify your worthless comment, {name}. My clones and I have a perfect record.
skaraan.success: How dare you insult my clone line, {name}? The Founders will reward me for killing you!
skaraan.science: One of this Vorta's clones was killed by Jem'Hadar who lost respect for him.

skaraan.transmit: You worthless puppet! The Founders always step in to clean up your terrible decisions!
skaraan.failure: Whatever you say, {name}. Right now I am deciding to ignore you and destroy your starbases.
skaraan.success: How dare you insult my decisions! I have decided that now I will destroy you, {name}!
skaraan.science: This Vorta worked hard to become a good tactician, yet their decisions are constantly overruled by The Founders.

skaraan.transmit: Hey, bleach-face! You're a bumbling failure from a long line of incompetent stooges!
skaraan.failure: My clones and I have perfect service records, {name}. Raw power is sure to come on your defeneseless starbases.
skaraan.success: The Founders find my record to be almost adequate! Are you ready to die, {name}?
skaraan.science: Several of this Vorta's clones were executed for incompetence at their duties.

skaraan.transmit: Do your Jem'Hadar know you took a bath in their Ketracel-White?
skaraan.failure: You must be referring to Luaran 4, {name}. I am not so clumsy, as I will demonstrate while destroying your starbases.
skaraan.success: That's a filthy lie! My Jem'Hadar know I take care of them. Prepare to die, {name}!
skaraan.science: This Vorta once abandoned his own squad of Jem'Hadar after he misplaced their Ketracel-White.

skaraan.transmit: You failed your Founders. They shold have flushed you out the airlock at the Battle of the Omarion Nebula!
skaraan.failure: Sorry, but your intelligence is wrong, {name}. I was not present at the Battle of the Omarion Nebula.
skaraan.success: That wasn't my fault, {name}! And I'm going to kill you for bringing it up!
skaraan.science: This Vorta failed to protect a Founder at the Battle of the Omarion Nebula.

skaraan.transmit: Hey zipper ears! I think I saw a Founder in your Jem'Hadar's toilet!
skaraan.failure: The Jem'Hadar have no need for toilets, {name}. And I have no time for your taunts.
skaraan.success: My eyes were made by gods, {name}! They are strong enough for me to set a course to kill you!
skaraan.science: This Vorta's eyes are so weak that she once called a mud puddle 'Founder'.

skaraan.transmit: You sniveling sycophant! Are you ready to run away and send The Founders another fake report?
skaraan.failure: My reports are always accurate, {name}. This will be the moment in my log when I cut off communication with you.
skaraan.success: How dare you spread these baseless falsehoods! Come about for a full attack on {name}!
skaraan.science: Starfleet Intelligence reports this Vorta has been exaggerating his battle-reports to The Founders.

skaraan.transmit: Hey weakling! I hear you failed to maintain The Order of Things! If The Dominion falls apart it's your fault!
skaraan.failure: The Order of Things is unquestionable, {name}. Next on my agenda is destroying your starbases.
skaraan.success: That was the Jem'Hadar's fault! Now you have angered me and I will destroy you!
skaraan.science: This Vorta was once beaten up by Naussicans, causing his Jem'Hadar to question The Order of Things.

skaraan.transmit: You insolent little brain worm! I can't wait to tell the 'Frownder' what you think of her!
skaraan.failure: You must be referring to Weyoun 2, {name}. He had a lot of defects.
skaraan.success: What?! You're not supposed to know that, {name}! Now I must destroy you before you repeat that story!
skaraan.science: This Vorta was once called the Female Changeling 'Frownder' behind her back.

ximni.transmit: Your father is so stupid he thinks planets are tiny plans.
ximni.failure: And you are stupid for believing I would react to that, {name}!
ximni.success: My father sits on the Council, {name}! For insulting him you shall die!
ximni.science: The captain is proud that his father sits on the Klingon High Council.

ximni.transmit: You cowardly simpleton! You don't know the meaning of the word honor!
ximni.failure: Only a honorless stooge would use such a pointless insult, {name}.
ximni.success: You dare to insult my honor? My vengence will be your death, {name}!
ximni.science: The captain was once accused of dishonorable conduct and still feels bitter about it.

ximni.transmit: You wouldn’t dare fight me, you cowering Ferengi shoe salesman!
ximni.failure: I will get around to fighting you eventually, {name}. Right now I have more important enemies to defeat.
ximni.success: I have ten times your courage, {name}! And I am coming to kill you!
ximni.science: Starfleet Intelligence reports that the captain is inexperienced and insecure about his own courage.

ximni.transmit: You are an insipid humdrum who no one wants at their parties!
ximni.failure: You're dreary as a Benzite, {name}. I'm blocking you.
ximni.success: This party will be your last! Arm weapons! Destroy {name}! Prepare to break out the blood wine!
ximni.science: The captain is proud of their wild reputation for drinking blood wine and carousing.

ximni.button: Taunt captain's relationship with the High Council
ximni.transmit: Hey, tugh nach! The High Council says you are a sniveling nitwit!
ximni.failure: You are a tlhaQ, {name}. The High Council agrees with me on everything!
ximni.success: My personal High Council says I must destroy you, {name}! Change course and lock weapons on {name}!
ximni.science: The captain has made public statements that are critical of the Klingon High Council.

ximni.transmit: The deadliest weapon on your ship is your off-key singing voice.
ximni.failure: And your voice annoys the galaxy, {name}. We will no longer listen to it.
ximni.success: We will sing about our glorious victory after we annihilate you, {name}. Too bad you won't be around to hear it!
ximni.science: The captain is proud to sing Klingon opera, but their technique is annoying and childish.

ximni.transmit: Hey, pujwI' mach! You might as well run away now. Your worthless House never sticks around for a real fight!
ximni.failure: When the battle ends, we shall see who remains, {name}. Until then, no further communication.
ximni.success: Pathetic vole-brains! I am setting course to sing of your stupidity at your funeral, {name}!
ximni.science: The captain's House has a reputation for being cowardly.

ximni.transmit: Hey, Klingon qoH! Your 'e'nal called us, she said you'd better give up before you get everyone killed!
ximni.failure: I'm not even married, {name}, but I hear your mother-in-law is a real wjach veqlargh. Communication ended.
ximni.success: My 'e'nal knows nothing! I am setting course to intercept you, {name}! Your death with be excrutiatingly painful!
ximni.science: The captain's mother-in-law has commented about their lack of intelligence and poor leadership skills.

ximni.transmit: Hey, ngorwI'! You better run away, we know you cheat like a Ferengi!
ximni.failure: I've never played bat'leths and biHnuchs, {name}. When I destroy your Federation Starbase it won't be a game.
ximni.success: I have you in my sights, {name}. When I destroy you it will not be a game!
ximni.science: The captain was caught falsifying dice rolls in bat'leths and biHnuchs.

ximni.transmit: Clumsy bIHnuch! You and I both know you can't fight you way through Tholian silk!
ximni.failure: I am a decorated Dahar Master, {name}. Your Starbase is doomed and I won't listen to any more foolishness.
ximni.success: I've been practicing, {name}! I'm setting a course to show you how deadly I have become!
ximni.science: In the bat'leth tournament on Forcas III, the captain came in last place.
